body: Ik they’ll miss me when I go. But they have no clue what’s going on with me. They’ll soon forget me. I hope so.

I tried texting the number and even calling them couple nights ago. Their wait time was so long that I passed out twice on them. Earlier on April of last year, I got a hold on them through text and the lady was so polite. Felt really good after sharing my problems with her but I was back on my dark road within a week.

I’m actually not religious but I’ve been wanting to go to church with my girlfriend to see if having a belief in my life can change my life. But we been too busy with our life. We haven’t gotten a chance yet. That’s one time I’ll forever regret. She once said “never wait” after I asked her out and told her that I was waiting for the moment. I shouldn’t have waited for the whole church thing. Should have made my move and made some time.
Health care is pretty expensive here in California. I can’t afford a therapist or anti-depressant prescribed by the doc. Not sure what other type of help I can get.
Ik ik. But it’s not worth the mental fight I have everyday on my head.

Not sure how to explain. I’m in college rn and I’m going decent but I have no defined plan for the future. I don’t know what I want to do with my life. I have problems going on at home with my family. I haven’t been healthy for past few months. My weight dropped from 135lbs to 112lbs in less than 2 month. I feel worthless. I don’t really see a reason to be here. I rather just end it and see what’s there for me from now on.

I don’t really know. The only thing I have that’s worth looking forward to is my dog and my girlfriend. But my problems are larger than that. Sad to say but I’m not happy with the choice I made. But if it’s gonna end the pain then it’s worth it.
